Players Committee errata sheet slip of [[Hondo Ohnaka (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. While at Audience Chamber (or stacked on your Objective), your other Weequays are deploy -1, power +1, and forfeit +2. Once per game, may deploy Aurra, Slave I, or a Kowakian from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-082022.pdf#page=1 Errata-082022.pdf], page 1 (PDF dated 6 August 2022). Rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi and cropped to the slip with its title label; no other edits.
